Interface IPaymentChargeClient

Namespace
NuvTools.Payment.Contracts
Assembly
NuvTools.Payment.dll

Moving money: charging a customer, and paying a payee.

public interface IPaymentChargeClient

Remarks

The two are separate calls on purpose. One charge can pay several payees, and a payee is paid for what was billed rather than for what each customer happened to pay — a customer who has not paid is a debt the platform carries, while a payee paid twice is a mistake nobody can take back.

Charges a saved payment method off-session — nobody is at a keyboard when a month is billed — and returns what the provider made of it.
